campaigns.name: Dead Water
campaigns.description: Mainline campaign: the merfolk of Jotha defend their home against an undead invasion.

campaigns.name: A Tale of Two Brothers
campaigns.description: Mainline campaign: a warrior is summoned home by his mage brother to drive off a dark mage's minions.

campaigns.name: Liberty
campaigns.description: Mainline campaign: a village militia leader rebels against increasingly tyrannical Wesnothian authority.

campaigns.name: Under the Burning Suns
campaigns.description: Mainline campaign: the last Quenoth elves flee their dying oasis -- Phase 11/12 testbed (shroud, fog, sighted, time areas, the two-suns schedule).

campaigns.name: [Debug] Combat
campaigns.description: Two adjacent leaders on a tiny grassland map -- for fast combat-math debugging, no setup turns needed.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Economy & Recruit
campaigns.description: A leader on a keep with a full castle ring, gold, and a short recruit list -- for fast economy/recruit debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Scenario Progression
campaigns.description: Two tiny scenarios chained by next_scenario=, with a real gold/recall carryover setup -- for fast progression debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Abilities & Specials
campaigns.description: 15 real mainline units, each demonstrating one weapon special or ability (poison, drains, berserk, firststrike, marksman, magical, backstab, charge, swarm, plague, heals, regenerate, skirmisher, leadership, illuminates) -- for fast specials/abilities debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Unit Advancement
campaigns.description: Two real units one combat-XP gain from leveling up -- one with a single real advances_to= option (advances immediately), one with three (opens the real advancement-choice dialog) -- for fast advancement debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Fog of War
campaigns.description: Two leaders on opposite corners of an empty board, each with fog=yes/shroud=yes, and two unexplored villages in the middle -- for fast shroud/fog debugging, no story setup needed.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Dialogue & Choices
campaigns.description: A blocking [message], a [move_unit_fake] flight, an [option] prompt that branches the scenario, a [text_input] and a [foreach] -- for fast Phase 17 event/dialogue debugging.

campaigns.name: [Debug] Animation
campaigns.description: An AI side that recruits and marches, a scripted spawn+move cutscene, a long Horseman ride and a fake unit -- each one click from a cold load, for debugging movement/appearance animation glitches.
